title: Booking not accepted — what to tell the customer
keywords: not accepted no agent repost tip increase acceptance rate deleted end of day
body: It means no available agent took the job. The customer can repost at a different time; unaccepted jobs are removed at the end of the day.
To improve acceptance: add a tip before payment, or to a posted job under Manage Deliveries.
Internally, CS still follows the Pending Acceptance SOP (top-ups, Lalamove) for priority accounts.
